question: Should OpenClaw allow WebChat-authored replies to be mirrored to a stored external route, and if so should that be a dedicated default-off session config or part of the broader origin-delivery policy?
rationale: The code path crosses from an internal operator surface to external messaging channels and adds config surface, so automation cannot choose the privacy, duplicate-delivery, and route-freshness policy safely.

options.title: Keep this as canonical opt-in mirroring
options.body: Accept a default-off session-level mirroring feature after defining stale-route, account/thread, duplicate, failure, docs, and live-proof requirements.

options.title: Fold into origin-delivery umbrella
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54531 the canonical policy and close this only after the broader design explicitly covers WebChat-to-external continuity.

options.title: Reject implicit mirroring
options.body: Document that WebChat remains internal unless explicit delivery is requested, and point users to supported message-send or origin-delivery workflows.

recommendation.title: Keep this as canonical opt-in mirroring
recommendation.body: Accept a default-off session-level mirroring feature after defining stale-route, account/thread, duplicate, failure, docs, and live-proof requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the live assignee and authored adjacent route-safety behavior for internal WebChat delivery.
